title: Exposing the (110) Facet of Single-Crystal LiMn2O4 Which Suppresses Surface Reconstruction and Enhances High-Temperature Cycling Stability
authors: Animesh Dutta, Saar Omessi, Renfei Feng, Jigang Zhou, Jian Wang, Jeffin James Abraham, Meng Yue, Matthew Garayt, J. R. Dahn and Chongyin Yang
abstract: Well-developed single crystal (SC) LiMn2O4 (LMO) particles with distinct exposed facets were synthesized to minimize parasitic reactions between the electrochemically active surface and the electrolyte. Laue diffraction was employed to identify, for the first time, (110)-faceted SC-LMO as distinct from its (111)-faceted counterpart. The (110)-faceted SC-LMO demonstrated superior electrochemical performance relative to (111)-faceted SC-LMO and commercial SC-LMO in half-cells at 55 °C.
